name: Draft chases for overdue invoices
description: Read Stripe for open invoices past their due date and draft the chase each one's stage calls for. Follow the stored procedures 'Which overdue invoices are never chased' — applied first — and 'How to write a chase at each stage'. Read the installation settings with the WorkflowManager_get_installation_params tool (slug 'invoice_chaser') and honour 'sender_name', 'never_chase' and 'max_chases'. Use the chase_stage function for each invoice's stage and whether the ladder has ended. Reply on the original thread where one exists, leave every chase as a draft, and report what was skipped and why.
